dedupe_keys.name: ecological risk due to future flow alteration across the 7 european stars4water river basins for 56 climate and hydrological model ensemble combinations

description: STARS4Water deposits ecological-flow risk results for 5,307 subcatchments across the Danube, Douro, Drammen, East Anglia, Messara, Rhine and Seine basins. The public README describes eight EURO-CORDEX climate scenarios crossed with seven hydrological ensemble members, giving 56 combinations. Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration scores compare a 1971 to 2000 baseline with 2031 to 2060 and 2061 to 2090 periods. Zenodo lists a ZIP, basin-reference CSV and README under CC BY 4.0. These scores can support a multi-basin climate-adaptation simulation by marking places where changed flow may constrain abstraction or habitat protection. They are calculated risk categories, not monitored species impacts or directly observed discharge. Upstream climate and hydrology datasets retain their separate provenance. The README was read, but the ZIP and basin-reference CSV were not opened, so identifier joins and numeric completeness remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this release.
